summary: All three phases delivered their stated objectives. Phase-01 is fully conformant: the Zod rewrite preserves the 30-case parser oracle exactly, only the three planned files were touched. Phase-02 has one justified unplanned file (main.test.ts, edited because the sandbox manifest now declares all 13 canonical concepts, making the pre-existing undeclared-concept fixture untestable against it). Phase-03 has one class of justified deviation: four files listed as 'planned to edit' (scope-map.ts, scope-map.test.ts, concept-map.ts, concept-map.test.ts) were deleted rather than edited, which is exactly what the plan's own instructions called for. No unjustified deviations, no missing promised tests or artifacts.
